D.t: Yassamin Ansari leads by 55.8 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 201,150 votes; a one point swing is about 1,804 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +49.4 and D +61.6. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
